WITH cohort AS (SELECT id FROM public.users WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'), orders_ranked AS (SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS ordered_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.user_id ORDER BY MIN(oi.created_at), oi.order_id) AS rn FROM public.order_items oi JOIN cohort c ON c.id = oi.user_id WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id), diffs AS (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.ordered_at - f.ordered_at))/86400.0 AS diff_days FROM orders_ranked f JOIN orders_ranked s ON s.user_id = f.user_id AND f.rn = 1 AND s.rn = 2) SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY diff_days) AS median_days FROM diffs

WITH cohort AS (SELECT id FROM public.users WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'), user_orders AS (SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time FROM public.order_items oi JOIN cohort c ON c.id = oi.user_id WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id), ranked AS (SELECT user_id, order_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time, order_id) AS rn FROM user_orders), piv AS (SELECT user_id, MAX(order_time) FILTER (WHERE rn = 2) AS second_time, MAX(order_time) FILTER (WHERE rn = 3) AS third_time FROM ranked GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (third_time - second_time))/86400.0))::numeric, 2) AS median_days FROM piv

WITH cohort AS (SELECT id FROM public.users WHERE traffic_source='Organic' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'), orders_grouped AS (SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time FROM public.order_items oi JOIN cohort c ON c.id = oi.user_id WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id), ranked AS (SELECT user_id, order_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time, order_id) AS rn FROM orders_grouped), first_two AS (SELECT user_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN order_time END) AS first_order, MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*)=2), diffs AS (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order - first_order))/86400.0 AS days_diff FROM first_two) SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff))::numeric, 2) AS median_days FROM diffs

WITH order_times AS (SELECT order_id, MIN(created_at) AS order_time, MIN(user_id) AS user_id FROM public.order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING MIN(created_at) >= '2024-01-01' AND MIN(created_at) < '2025-01-01'), order_values AS (SELECT ot.order_id, ot.user_id, ot.order_time, SUM(oi.sale_price) AS order_value FROM order_times ot JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = ot.order_id WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY ot.order_id, ot.user_id, ot.order_time), ranked AS (SELECT order_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time, order_id) AS rn FROM order_values) SELECT (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1) - (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FROM ranked WHERE rn > 1) AS diff

WITH orders AS (SELECT user_id, order_id, MIN(created_at) AS order_time FROM public.order_items WHERE status <> 'Cancelled' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY user_id, order_id), ranked AS (SELECT user_id, order_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time, order_id) AS rn FROM orders), diffs AS (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN order_time END)-MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN order_time END)))/86400.0 AS days_diff FROM ranked WHERE rn<=2 GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*)=2) SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff))::numeric, 2) AS p95_days FROM diffs

WITH cohort AS (SELECT id FROM public.users WHERE traffic_source = 'Search' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'), ord AS (SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS t FROM public.order_items oi JOIN cohort c ON c.id = oi.user_id WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY 1,2), ranked AS (SELECT user_id, t, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t) AS rn FROM ord), fs AS (SELECT user_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN t END) AS f, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN t END) AS s FROM ranked GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s - f))/86400.0))::numeric, 2) AS median_days FROM fs
